chapter: Depression-era Chicago: jobs, marriage, first bands
title: Chicago bands: Fambrough, Earle Warren and his own group at Joe's Deluxe
summary: He worked with Tony Fambrough, Earle Warren's band at Joe Louis's club, Boyd Atkins and led his own group.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Can you talk about some of the bands that you played with at this time? This is now moving to the ’30s.
I played with a lot of different local bands and worked with different groups.
What kind of gigs were they?

There was Tony Fambrough. There was – I worked with – Earle Warren had a band that worked in a club that Joe Louis fronted. That was with Earle Warren’s band. Then there was another group that I worked with in a nightclub setting.
Oh, that was my own thing, my own nightclub band that I went out and worked . . .
. . . in Chicago. That was my own thing. I worked at Joe’s Deluxe with that band, with that group.
